mutations.because: Authorisation unwired: mayDelete always returns true, so a member on an org-wide campaign receives 202 instead of the required 403.
command: DELETE /campaigns/:id answers 403 for a member on an org-wide campaign and writes nothing

mutations.because: fs guard removed: an fs request falls into the postgres path, where resolveCampaign cannot see a versionless campaign (it answers only from brief files), so the route answers 404 and the file-store delete never runs.
command: DELETE /campaigns/:id deletes a campaign that has no saved version on the file store

mutations.because: grace not wired: not_before is always now() instead of now() + PURGE_GRACE_HOURS, so the grace-period test fails.
actor not recorded: deleted_by and requested_by become 'x' instead of the caller userId, so the tombstone test fails.
command: DELETE /campaigns/:id answers 202 and tombstones the campaign for an admin

mutations.before: return { error: `Campaign "${id}" has a run in progress.`, jobId: result.jobId };
mutations.after: return { error: `Campaign "${id}" has a run in progress.` };
mutations.because: 409 body without the job: jobId is omitted, so the jobId assertion fails.
command: DELETE /campaigns/:id answers 409 with the running jobId and writes nothing

mutations.because: a lost race is not a 404: the gone case returns 200 with a body instead of the required 404 not-found body.
command: DELETE /campaigns/:id answers 404 when the transaction finds the campaign already gone
